Actually, the key verification is solid:
- drush status: Drupal bootstrap Successful, Install profile: openculturas, Drupal 11.3.17, PHP 8.4.24, DB connected
- Homepage renders: HTTP 200, title "Welcome | OpenCulturas"
- drush uli works (full site bootstrap + user system functional)

Let me count enabled modules and node count cleanly to round out verification. Let me write the php-eval to a file properly (the issue is the shell passing the string). Let me use a file approach.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Enabled module count ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush pm:status -y --fields=enabled 2>/dev/null | grep -c "true"
echo "=== Total enabled extension (module+theme) ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush config:get core.extension module -y 2>/dev/null | grep -c ":"
echo "=== Node table rows ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec mysql -udb -pdb db -N -B -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Content types installed ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush ent:up --entity-type=node_type 2>&1 | tail -2
